mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% each in a month signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a simultaneous increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure despite easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over three months signals a strong economic environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, unless there is a simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, which would indicate a potential labor market weakness.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases over 3 months, unless UNRATE increases > 0.3%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases over three months, unless UNRATE increases by more than 0.3%, in which case the hypothesis is not applicable.
